The whole secular culture seems to think we prep for holidays by mini celebrations beforehand until a big party the day of and then you move to the next festivity. No!!!!!! NOVEMBER IS SPOOKY SEASON. NOVEMBER IS THE MONTH OF THE HOLY SOULS. NOW IS THE TIME FOR SKULLS. MEMENTO MORI. GRAVE STONES. TREES DON'T HAVE LEAVES. EVERYTHING IS DEAD.

October is Harvest Season. Abundance and wealth and dying things turning gold. November is Dead Season. Get it RIGHT.

This is not the first time a third party has scraped AO3 in order to profit from stolen work, and it won't be the last. Do not give these sites your email, do not give them any personal information, do not comply with their demands for info in order to have your works removed. Do not assume they are acting in good faith or will do anything they say they will. And please don't reblog posts encouraging others to give them information.

In the case of the latest one it seems that OTW legal is already on it. If you want to do something, you can report the site to its domain holder and webhost for stolen content.

Don't panic. Don't give out your information because someone told you you have to. Take a deep breath and learn what you can about the situation before you act.

Afbeelding: Panel 5: Val, still smiling, sweats a bit and looks worried, with an arrow labeling her "(not sure how to take that)". "What are YOU going as?" she asks.
Afbeelding: Panel 6: Audrey smiles radiantly and replies enthusiastically: "A cat!"
Afbeelding: Panel 7: "Oh. Cool," Val replies, smiling indecipherably.
Afbeelding: Panel 10: "Val! Over here!" a voice calls from the side as she turns her head.
Afbeelding: Panel 12: Val just stands there flabbergasted, mouth hanging open.
Afbeelding: Panel 13: Audrey points at his whisker-lined face with a gloved hand as says "I'm Old Deuteronomy from CATS."
